programme.title: Good Kill (2014)
programme.desc: A disillusioned drone pilot, who controls spy aircrafts hovering over the Middle East from a trailer in Las Vegas, begins to feel morally disconnected from his military orders.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate (2019)
programme.desc: Two decades after the events of the first Terminator movie, an aging Sarah Connor joins forces with a cybernetically-enhanced female soldier from 2042?and her former nemesis, the T800?to protect a young girl from an advanced Terminator model from the dystopian future.

programme.title: The Mexican (2001)
programme.desc: An inept criminal's girlfriend is kidnapped while he is in Mexico trying to pull off one final job.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity (2016)
programme.desc: The life of mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan is detailed in this biopic. Despite opposition in the forms of early-life poverty and constant racism, he became one of the most important and revolutionary pioneers in his field.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate (2013)
programme.desc: The true story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his epic struggle against the US government over classified intelligence documents that were exposed for public scrutiny.

programme.title: Snake Eyes (1998)
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars in this highly stylized 1998 thriller directed by Brain De Palma. Cage plays a crooked cop investigating the assassination of the Secretary of Defense, who was shot at a championship boxing match in Atlantic City. As the investigation proceeds, he is forced to realizes that one of his closest friends (Gary Sinise), a Navy commander, may have been involved.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies (2015)
programme.desc: In this historical drama set during the Cold War, an attorney is tasked with negotiating a prisoner exchange between an American pilot who was shot down over the USSR and a Soviet spy serving a 45-year sentence for espionage against the US.

programme.title: Deadlock (2022)
programme.desc: Following his son's death at the hands of the police, criminal Ron Whitlock embarks on a quest for revenge. Assembling a team of mercenaries in a plot to overthrow the government, Whitlock seizes power at a government-owned nuclear power plant, ultimately threatening the destruction of a nearby town until a retired Army ranger vows to face Whitlock head-on.

programme.title: Ain't Them Bodies Saints (2013)
programme.desc: In 1970s Texas, a notorious outlaw claims responsibility for his wife's murder of a police officer. Years later, he attempts to break out of prison to reunite with his beloved and their daughter.

programme.title: Patriots Day (2016)
programme.desc: Docudrama about the 2013 Boston Marathon bombing and subsequent manhunt.

programme.title: Before Dawn (2024)
programme.desc: Jim Collins, a Western Australian sheep farmer, leaves his home and the life he knows to join the Australian war effort in France during World War I. There, he faces the horrors of war that, as he relates them to his upbringing in a more peaceful, unchallenged world, slowly transforms him from a frightened young man into a heroic figure.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies (2015)
programme.desc: In this historical drama set during the Cold War, an attorney is tasked with negotiating a prisoner exchange between an American pilot who was shot down over the USSR and a Soviet spy serving a 45-year sentence for espionage against the US.

programme.title: Ida Red (2021)
programme.desc: After being given 20 years in prison for armed robbery, career criminal Ida "Red" Walker fears that she won't survive long enough to see through her sentence due to being diagnosed with a terminal illness. Intent on staging one last heist, she turns to her son and right hand Wyatt to help her bring her plans to completion, and to give her a chance to regain her freedom.

programme.title: The Assistant (2019)

programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks in Game 2 of the Eastern Conference finals. From Madison Square Garden. Indiana erased a 14-point deficit in the final three minutes of regulation and had a 27-4 edge in points off turnovers. The Knicks are 3-4 at MSG this postseason.

Ninth-year forward Pascal Siakam exploded for 39 points in Game 2, while Jalen Brunson's 39.5 ppg and eight assists/game have not been enough for the Knicks, who now look to build on their 5-1 road record this postseason.

Up 3-2, Tyrese Haliburton and the Pacers remain one win away from their second-ever NBA Finals, coming home to a court where they are 10-1 all-time vs. New York in the playoffs. After allowing 43 first-quarter points here in Game 4, the Knicks held Indy to 45 in the first half in taking Game 5 by 17 points.

programme.title: NBA Finals
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 1 of the best-of-seven NBA championship series. From Paycom Center. Tyrese Haliburton paces potent Indiana in its first Finals in 25 years, while league MVP and fellow guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander stars for a deep, defense-minded OKC squad. The Thunder's 68 regular-season wins to Indy's 50 marks the largest difference in an NBA Finals since 1981, when Boston (62 wins) took out Houston (40) in six games.

Kyrie Irving and Luka Doncic tallied 33 points each in a 116-107 Game 3 win, with Doncic contributing five steals and Daniel Gafford adding three blocks.

Luka Doncic (triple double) had little help in the loss, though his Mavs still have three shots at advancing to their first Finals since 2011.

programme.title: NBA Hardwood Classics
programme.desc: Dallas Mavericks at Boston Celtics in Game 5 of the 2025 NBA Finals. Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown combined for just 25 points in the loss, while Mavs star Luka Doncic netted 29, to go with three steals.

The Ambersons' magnificent lives are apparent as the film opens, as is their sense of propriety. Welles, who directed, produced and adapted the screenplay from Booth Tarkington's novel, also provides the narration. Remade as a 2002 made-for-cable film.
